summary: Inspected TauCeti/LowDimTopology/Heegaard/Admissibility.lean (6371 bytes). The file contains four substantial formal theorems about weak admissibility of Heegaard diagrams: equivalence with existence of positive area forms vanishing on periodic domains, area invariance for domains with matching basepoint multiplicities, finiteness of nonnegative domains connecting generators with prescribed basepoint data, and equivalence of weak admissibility with finiteness of nonnegative periodic domains. summary: All four files contain substantial formal mathematical content in low-dimensional topology / Heegaard Floer theory. CircleTimesSphere.lean defines the S¹×S² genus-one Heegaard diagram with 15+ theorems on periodic domains, weak admissibility, and Maslov indices. CurveHomology.lean develops the ε(x,y) class of Ozsváth–Szabó with definitions for arcBoundary, domainBoundary, arcCycles, curveCycles, arcRelations, CurveHomology, IsConnectingChain, and epsilon, plus 8 main theorems. Generator.lean provides the foundational HeegaardIntersectionSystem structure and Generator type with 10+ theorems on generator construction, counting, and chains. RealProjectiveSpace.lean defines the ℝP³ genus-one diagram with theorems proving no domain connects its generators, ε(p₀,p₁) ≠ 0, and its order is 2. All files contain definitions, statements, and proofs directly relevant to search — none are pure import aggregators or documentation-only.
